newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day repo tender at 3.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day repo tender at 3.0 percent.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of three percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Wednesday and the securities have to be repurchased on July 2.
A 82.1 billion-mark facility at a fixed rate of three percent expires Wednesday. The repo rate has been fixed at three percent since late August.
